title: Hypoxia-induced regulation of zDHHC23 opens avenues for new biomarkers for NON MYCN-amplified neuroblastoma
authors: Oswald SO; Daly LA; Clarke K; Brownridge PJ; Pizer B; Prior IA; Sée V; Eyers CE
one_liner_zh: 该文研究神经母细胞瘤中zDHHC23的缺氧调控与预后标志物，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neuroblastoma is a highly metastatic paediatric malignancy with poor prognosis, and remains a leading cause of paediatric cancer mortality. Current risk stratification is disproportionately reliant on MYCN amplification, a feature present in only ∼25% of cases. This narrow focus neglects the majority of patients that have non- MYCN amplified tumours, limiting opportunities for therapeutic innovation. To define molecular drivers of metastasis in non -MYCN amplified neuroblastoma and identify putative prognostic markers, we leveraged our validated in vivo chick embryo xenograft model to profile oxygen-sensitive transcriptional changes, revealing a cohort of ∼400 genes associated with metastatic competence. Integrative survival analysis using two independent patient cohorts identified 59 genes predictive of event-free survival in non- MYCN amplified disease. Among these, the poorly characterized Zinc Finger DHHC-Type Palmitoyltransferase 23 (zDHHC23) emerged as a robust prognostic candidate. Proteomic interrogation of zDHHC23 under varying oxygen conditions uncovered dynamic interactome remodelling, notably hypoxia-attenuated association with the 26S proteasome and the TIM23 mitochondrial import complex. These findings suggest zDHHC23 as a hypoxia-responsive regulator linked to metastatic signalling, and a promising target for biomarker development and therapeutic intervention in high-risk, non-MYCN amplified neuroblastoma.
abstract_zh: 神经母细胞瘤是一种高度转移性的儿科恶性肿瘤，预后不良，并且仍然是儿童癌症死亡的主要原因。当前的风险分层过度依赖于MYCN扩增，而这一特征仅存在于约25%的病例中。这种狭窄的关注忽视了大多数具有非MYCN扩增肿瘤的患者，限制了治疗创新的机会。为了定义非MYCN扩增神经母细胞瘤中转移的分子驱动因素并识别潜在的预后标志物，我们利用经过验证的体内鸡胚异种移植模型，分析了氧敏感性转录变化，揭示了一组与转移能力相关的约400个基因。使用两个独立患者队列的综合生存分析确定了59个预测非MYCN扩增疾病无事件生存的基因。其中，特征不明确的锌指DHHC型棕榈酰转移酶23（zDHHC23）成为一个稳健的预后候选基因。在不同氧条件下对zDHHC23的蛋白质组学分析揭示了动态的相互作用组重塑，特别是缺氧减弱了其与26S蛋白酶体和TIM23线粒体输入复合物的关联。这些发现表明，zDHHC23是一个与转移信号相关的缺氧响应调节因子，并且是高危非MYCN扩增神经母细胞瘤中生物标志物开发和治疗干预的有前景靶点。
